evidence: Matches RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies JSON-RPC request parsing in src/rpc/request.cpp.
rationale: Fixes an RPC batch processing bug where malformed batch elements reuse preceding element IDs or silently drop error responses. As noted in the description, when an invalid non-object item follows another call, 'the reply has two objects with "id":"X", one with a result and one with an error. If the first element is a notification, the error is dropped.'
